units.source_text: “综合分析夫人的态度后，我得出了结论，自己在这户人家里受到了充分的信任，

en.t: After considering the lady's attitude as a whole, I concluded that I was fully trusted in this household,

units.source_text: 甚至找出了从初次见面就受到信任的证据。

en.t: and I even found evidence that I had been trusted from our very first meeting.

units.source_text: 这一发现，对于已经开始疑神疑鬼的我，是一个小小的震动。

en.t: This discovery gave a small shock to me, who had already begun to suspect everything.

units.source_text: 我想，和男人相比，女人恐怕更富于直觉。

en.t: I thought that women were probably richer in intuition than men.

units.source_text: 而女人之所以被男人欺骗，原因恐怕也在这里。

en.t: And I thought this was probably also why women were deceived by men.

units.source_text: 这样观察夫人的我，对于小姐也怀有同样强烈的直觉。

en.t: While observing the lady in this way, I also had the same strong intuition about the young lady.

units.source_text: 现在想来很好笑，虽然我在心里发誓不相信别人，却绝对相信小姐。

en.t: It seems funny to me now, but although I had sworn in my heart not to trust others, I trusted the young lady absolutely.

units.source_text: 可是，对信任我的夫人却满腹猜疑。

en.t: Yet I was full of suspicion toward the lady who trusted me.

units.source_text: 我不太愿意谈家乡的事，

en.t: I was not very willing to talk about my hometown,

units.source_text: 对那场变故更是只字未提，

en.t: and I said not a word about that incident in particular,

units.source_text: 就连想起那些事都觉得不快。

en.t: for even thinking of those things made me feel unpleasant.

units.source_text: 我尽可能听夫人说话，

en.t: I tried as much as possible to listen to the lady speak,

units.source_text: 可夫人不答应，

en.t: but the lady would not allow it,

units.source_text: 一有机会就想打听我老家的情况。

en.t: and whenever she had the chance, she wanted to ask about my old home.

units.source_text: 终于，我全都说了，

en.t: At last, I told her everything,

units.source_text: 还说，我再也不想回故乡了，

en.t: and I also said that I no longer wanted to return to my hometown,

units.source_text: 即使回去，也什么都没有了，只有父母的坟墓。

en.t: and that even if I went back, there would be nothing left there except my parents' graves.

units.source_text: 夫人听了感动得不行，小姐也哭了。

en.t: The lady was deeply moved when she heard this, and the young lady cried as well.

units.source_text: 我觉得自己这么做是做对了，心里很愉快。

en.t: I felt that I had done the right thing, and I was very pleased at heart.

units.source_text: 听我说出一切后，夫人脸上露出了果然不出所料的神情。

en.t: After hearing me tell everything, the lady's face showed an expression that said it was just as she had expected.

units.source_text: 从那以后，夫人对待我就像对自己的亲戚或某个小辈一样。

en.t: From then on, the lady treated me as if I were one of her relatives or some younger member of the family.

units.source_text: 我没有生气，甚至感到高兴，谁知，过了不久，我的疑心病又犯了。

en.t: I was not angry; I was even pleased. But before long, my suspicious nature returned again.
